protocol: Modified Loughborough Intermittent Shuttle Test (6 blocks) 1 h after a standard breakfast with placebo (PLA arm of a 4-arm crossover); BP at baseline, 1 h after drink, 1 h after exercise; HR 1 h after drink, in blocks 1-6 and 1 h after; lactate after each block; FFA at baseline, 1 h after drink, immediately after and 1 h after exercise
note: Read only the PLA rows; FFA, lactate, HR and BP all tabulated for one intermittent running bout. The trial followed a glycogen-lowering ride the day before (see Methods), which shifts FFA and lactate.
